what_it_does: Google's search, display and video advertising platform.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (user flow or service account) via a Google Cloud project with the Google Ads API enabled. Developer tokens were sunset on 2026-09-09; existing tokens are ignored and access level is now tied to the Cloud project. Manager (MCC) account only needed to manage multiple accounts; login-customer-id header for manager access.
access_notes: Enabling the API gives Test access (test accounts only, 15k ops/day). Explorer access (production accounts, 2,880 ops/day; no account creation/linking, user mgmt, Keyword/Reach planning, billing) is applied for in Cloud Console and usually auto-approved. Basic (15k ops/day) needs brand verification of the Cloud project; reviewed within minutes. Standard (unlimited) needs a manual audit (~10 business days), may require demo access and Required Minimum Functionality. Docs warn free-trial or suspended billing accounts may be rejected for Explorer/Basic.
api_notes: Google Ads API (gRPC with REST interface): campaigns, ad groups, ads, assets, bidding, reporting via GAQL Search/SearchStream, keyword/reach planning, conversions, audiences.
human_needed: complete brand verification / apply for Basic or Standard access on the Cloud project; OAuth consent verification for the adwords scope

what_it_does: Facebook and Instagram ad campaign management and reporting via Marketing API.
auth_notes: Facebook Login OAuth dialog requesting ads_management / ads_read; access tokens (user or system user tokens from Business Manager) passed to the Graph-based Marketing API.
access_notes: Business apps get Standard access by default: usable on own/granted ad accounts against production data, but heavy dev-only rate limits and some calls unavailable. Managing other people's ad accounts requires Advanced Access to ads_read/ads_management via App Review; business verification required for sensitive data. Advanced access is kept only with >=1,500 Marketing API calls in 15 days and <15% error rate.
api_notes: Marketing API on Graph API: campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, insights, audiences, catalogs, Business Manager, Conversions API.
human_needed: pass App Review for ads_management/ads_read Advanced Access and complete business verification

what_it_does: LinkedIn B2B advertising campaigns, targeting and analytics via Advertising API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (3-legged) flow; access tokens last 60 days; programmatic refresh tokens only for a limited set of partners, otherwise re-authorize. Scopes like rw_ads require specific ad account roles.
access_notes: Requires a LinkedIn Page and developer app, then applying for the Advertising API under the app's Products tab with an access form (use case must be supported). Development tier: unlimited reads, create 1 test ad account, edit up to 5 ad accounts. Standard tier requested via Developer Support ticket; LinkedIn reviews at its discretion and may decline. No approval timeline documented.
api_notes: Versioned Marketing (LMS) REST APIs: ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, reporting/analytics, targeting; Matched Audiences, Lead Sync, Conversions APIs gated separately.
human_needed: create LinkedIn Page, apply for Advertising API access, request Standard tier via support ticket

what_it_does: All-in-one CRM, funnels and marketing automation platform for agencies.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant for Marketplace apps (Company/agency vs Location/sub-account tokens; ~24h access tokens, 1-year rotating refresh tokens; no PKCE). Private Integration Tokens (scoped bearer tokens) for internal use. Legacy API keys being phased out; API v1 end-of-support 2025-12-31.
access_notes: API access included on Starter ($97/mo), Unlimited ($297/mo) and Founder ($497/mo, formerly Agency Pro); some endpoints (create sub-account, SaaS) Founder-only. Marketplace Developer Portal offers sandbox (app test) accounts with trial Enterprise features for up to 6 months; whether developer portal/sandbox is free without a subscription was not confirmed.
api_notes: API v2 (and v3 for some endpoints): contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, workflows, payments, sub-accounts etc. Rate limit 100 req/10s burst, 200k/day per app per resource.
human_needed: hold a paid HighLevel plan (or confirm free sandbox via Marketplace developer portal)
